title: Human Resources Manager
description:
We are looking for a Experienced HR Manager with proven expertise in the construction sector, preferably handling Exposure to infrastructure projects. The role requires a strong leader who can manage workforce planning across multiple project sites, ensure compliance with labor laws, and align HR strategy with organizational goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end HR operations across multiple infra structure project sites.
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and deployment of manpower (staff \& contract workers).
* Supervise preparation of labor payment sheets, payroll, and compliance reports.
* Ensure adherence to labor laws, safety standards, and statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, gratuity, etc.).
* Build strong employee relations at site and corporate levels, managing grievance redressal and conflict resolution.
* Coordinate with project heads to assess manpower requirements and align with project deadlines.
* Maintain and review HRMS data, attendance records, and employee documentation.
* Prepare and present monthly HR MIS reports to management.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Graduate with 5–10 years of HR experience, including at least 3\+ years in construction projects (roads/bridges preferred).
* In\-depth knowledge of labor law compliance, site HR operations, and contract workforce management.
* Strong leadership and team management skills to handle site\-based workforce challenges.
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and communication abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel, and HRMS tools.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of how HR decisions impact project profitability and timelines.

**Salary Range**

* Higher Start in salary can be consider for deserving and experience and industry)

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Head - Student placements
description:
Job DescriptionPosition: Head – Student Placements

**Location:** Technovalley, Kochi  
**Reporting to:** General Manager – Sales \& Marketing / COO

**About Technovalley**

Technovalley is a global high\-technology consulting and skilling company, recognized as a leader in deep\-tech education and certifications in India. With global partnerships (EC\-Council, OffSec, Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, IBM, CompTIA, NASSCOM, KKEM, etc.) and 140\+ programs across Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Full Stack, Cloud \& Emerging Technologies, Technovalley has trained thousands of students and professionals, empowering them for global careers.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a dynamic and highly experienced professional to lead **Student Placements** at Technovalley. The **Head – Student Placements** will be responsible for creating, managing, and scaling strong placement networks with IT companies, startups, MNCs, and government agencies, ensuring 100% placement assistance to our learners.

This role requires **a proven track record of successfully placing IT students** in reputed organizations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the **Placements Division** and manage the end\-to\-end placement process for students across Cybersecurity, Data Science, AI, Full Stack, and related programs.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR managers, recruiters, and industry leaders to secure placement opportunities.
* Design and execute placement drives, job fairs, and campus connect programs.
* Develop career pathways and placement strategies tailored to industry demand.
* Guide students on interview preparation, resume building, and professional readiness.
* Collaborate with academic and training teams to align student skillsets with employer requirements.
* Track, measure, and report placement metrics to management.
* Continuously expand Technovalley’s employer network across India and abroad.

**Requirements**

* Minimum **5–10 years of proven experience** in student placement, talent acquisition, or corporate relations, **preferably in the IT / EdTech sector**.
* Strong existing network with IT recruiters, MNCs, and technology companies.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to lead a team and deliver on aggressive placement targets.
* Passion for student success and career building.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with **India’s most advanced tech skilling company**.
* High\-growth role with strong leadership visibility.
* Attractive salary \+ performance incentives.
* Chance to make a real impact by enabling thousands of students to secure global careers.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹320,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:

**Sr. Executive \- Human Resources**

Location: Sector 155 Noida

Experience: \- 0\-3 Years

Role Summary

We are looking for a self\- driven HR professional who can take ownership of hiring and core HR responsibilities with minimal supervision. The role requires the ability to understand business requirements, communicate effectively and execute tasks with accountability and attention to detail.

Draft clear and structured job description.

Maintain employee records and HR data.

Assist in implementing HR processes and policies.

Act as a coordination point between employees and management where required.

Ensure timelines are adhered to without constant supervision.

Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently.

Good command over English and Hindi (Verbal and written).

Ability to write structured clear and professional’s emails.

Organized, detail oriented and responsive.

Graduate/Postgraduate in human resources or related field.

Candidates with 2\-3 years of experience in HR or recruitment.

Freshers with strong communication skills may also be considered.

title: Associate Director, Organizational Systems Analyst
description:
**About the Role:**  

**Grade Level (for internal use):** 12
  
  

**The Role:**  

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate Director, Organizational Systems Analysis, to join S\&P Global’s People team. In this role, you will help build and deliver data\-driven and Tech/AI\-enabled people team solutions to our leaders and our people. Particular product focus will be in team effectiveness, upskilling \& reskilling, job\-redesign, career mapping, training, recognition, and engagement of our people with a skills\-based, people forward approach. You will be on the cutting edge of embedding AI\-, analytical, and digital delivery of our people capabilities!
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Organizational Systems and Analytics
  
  

Collaborate with other Workforce Planning \& Future of work teams to deliver critical job and work re\-design engagements to support business operating model, process re\-engineering, and org design plans.
  
  

Conduct systems analysis on organizational data to identify trends, patterns, and insights related to ‘people workflows’
  
  

Partner with HR business partners and leadership to translate business questions into talent strategy frameworks and provide data\-driven recommendations
  
  

Lead special analytics projects that drive organizational effectiveness and support global business objectives that can be solved with automated systems.
  
  

Provides technical expertise in identifying, evaluating and developing organizational and talent systems and procedures that are cost effective, scalable and meet user requirements.
  
  

**Internal Consulting Services:**  

Support internal consulting engagements to People Partners, Finance Partners, and business stakeholders in achieving their people and financial objectives.
  
  

Work with Talent, Total Rewards, and other People functions to guide and optimize talent strategy for consulting engagements.
  
  

Address specific organizational challenges by supporting tailored solutions and strategic advice in collaboration with people team partners.
  
  

Provides support of multi\-functional efforts to identify, interpret and produce recommendations based on company systems needs.
  
  

Advises business groups by providing technical and strategic direction to identify and address business issues and opportunities.
  
  

**Data \& Analytics Partnership:**  

Partner with People Data and People Analytics to build data and analytics to guide KPIs and ROI for the organizational effectiveness solutions.
  
  

Work with relevant vendor partners to scope and manage execution of roll\-out, product enhancement, and integration plans
  
  

Collaborate with people data, people technology and AI\+ strategists to deliver AI tooling to various people team stakeholder
  
  

Work closely with People Analytics team to contribute to reports, dashboards, models, and tools that enhance the usage of workforce and organizational analytics as well as the integration of benchmarks, workforce planning best practices, and alternative data sets
  
  

**What We’re Looking For:****Qualifications:**  

Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Psychology, Business, or related field
  
  

10\+ years of experience in HR analytics, people analytics, or business intelligence roles
  
  

Proficiency in analytical tools and programming languages such as R, Python, SQL, or similar statistical software
  
  

Experience with data visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, or similar business intelligence tools
  
  

Strong understanding of HR metrics, workforce analytics, and people data interpretation
  
  

Excellent communication skills with ability to present complex analytical findings to non\-technical stakeholders
  
  

**Additional Preferred Qualifications:**  

Master's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Industrial Psychology, or related quantitative field
  
  

Experience with advanced statistical techniques including predictive modeling, machine learning, or multivariate analysis
  
  

Knowledge of HR information systems such as Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar HRIS platforms
  
  

Previous experience in consulting or advisory roles supporting business decision\-making through analytics
  
  

What’s In It For You?
  
  

**Our Mission:**  

Advancing Essential Intelligence.
  
  

**Our People:**  

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.
  
  

**Our Values:**  

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership
  
  

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  

**Benefits:**  

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S\&P Global.
  
  

**Our benefits include:**  

**Health \& Wellness:** Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
  
  

**Flexible Downtime:** Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
  
  

**Continuous Learning:** Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
  
  

**Invest in Your Future:** Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company\-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
  
  

**Family Friendly Perks:** It’s not just about you. S\&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best\-in class benefits for families.
  
  

**Beyond the Basics:** From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.
  
**For more information on benefits by country visit:** https://spgbenefits.com/benefit\-summaries
  
  

**Global Hiring and Opportunity at S\&P Global:**  

At S\&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.
  
  

**Recruitment Fraud Alert:**  

If you receive an email from a spglobalind.com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal.com . S\&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, “pre\-employment training” or for equipment/delivery of equipment. Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here .

S\&P Global is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military veteran status, unemployment status, or any other status protected by law. Only electronic job submissions will be considered for employment.
  
  

If you need an accommodation during the application process due to a disability, please send an email to: EEO.Compliance@spglobal.com and your request will be forwarded to the appropriate person.

description:
**Date:** 11 Apr 2026


**Location:** Gurugram, India


**Company:** Sterlite Power Transmission Limited


**Position Title**
------------------



Manager \- Compliance and Legal

**Purpose of Role**
-------------------



The Compliance Officer is responsible for monitoring and ensuring statutory and regulatory compliance across corporate functions and project sites of the organization.



The role involves overseeing compliance reporting, interpreting regulatory requirements applicable to the power transmission sector, assessing applicability of new laws and regulations, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure timely compliance across locations.

**Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities**
-------------------------------------------


* Monitor and ensure statutory and regulatory compliance across corporate functions, project sites, and operational units in accordance with applicable central, state, and sector\-specific laws.
* Oversee compliance reporting through the compliance management system and ensure that designated users across locations complete compliance filings accurately and within prescribed timelines.
* Monitor compliance dashboards, track pending actions, and follow up with responsible departments or site teams to ensure timely closure of compliance obligations.
* Provide guidance to internal stakeholders on compliance requirements and resolve queries relating to interpretation or applicability of statutory provisions.
* Conduct periodic compliance reviews across corporate departments and project sites to assess implementation status and identify potential risks or gaps.
* Prepare and submit compliance review reports to management highlighting key compliance risks, gaps, and recommended corrective actions.
* Assess the applicability of new laws, regulations, and regulatory updates relevant to the power transmission sector, including those related to electricityregulations, land acquisition, environmental approvals, and project development.
* Review compliance implications arising from new projects, transmission line construction, substations, expansions, or operational changes.
* Coordinate with internal departments such as Legal, Project Development, Engineering, Finance, HR, EHS, and Procurement to ensure timely implementation of applicable compliance requirements.
* Track amendments in central and state laws relevant to infrastructure and power transmission operations and communicate regulatory updates and their impact to management and relevant teams.
* Support statutory inspections, regulatory filings, and interactions with government authorities, regulators, and auditors as required.
* Assist in internal and external compliance audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Maintain compliance documentation, records, and reporting frameworks at the corporate level.
**Critical Success Factors \- Essential**
-----------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Law, or a related discipline (LLB preferred).
* 5\-7 years of experience in corporate compliance, regulatory compliance, or legal/compliance roles within infrastructure, power, energy, or related sectors.
**Critical Success Factors \- Desirable**
-----------------------------------------


* Strong understanding of statutory and regulatory compliance frameworks in India
* Ability to interpret laws and assess regulatory applicability across projects and locations
* Strong analytical, documentation, and reporting skills
* Effective communication and stakeholder management across departments and sites
* Attention to detail and strong follow\-up capabilities
* Ability to work independently and manage compliance monitoring at a corporate level

Resonia Limited is uniquely positioned to solve the toughest challenges of energy delivery.



We are guided by our core purpose of empowering humanity by addressing the toughest challenges of energy delivery. Our four core values form the pillars of our organization:

**Location: Malad (West), Mumbai**

**Only Mumbai Suburban\-based candidates apply for this Position (Bhayander to Dadar).**  
**We are 6 days working: Monday to Saturday**

**Objective of the Role:**

The HR Manager will be responsible for driving HR Operations and overseeing Talent Acquisition (20%), while ensuring strong governance, compliance, employee engagement, and cultural alignment. The role demands hands\-on expertise in HR operations, audit compliance (ISO, SOC 2\), performance management, employee relations, and policy framing, along with the ability to leverage AI tools and HR chatbots for operational efficiency.

**Job Description:**

1\. **HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management:**

* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations, including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, role changes, and exits.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records, HR MIS, and documentation.
* Oversee HR workflows to ensure consistency, compliance, and efficiency.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational HR matters.

2\. **Policy Framework, Rules \& Regulations:**

* Address employee concerns and conflicts in a fair and timely manner.
* Ensure policies are aligned with organizational goals, legal requirements, and compliance standards.
* Communicate policies effectively and ensure organization\-wide adherence.
* Periodically review policies to support evolving business and workforce needs.

3\. **Compliance, Audit \& Governance:**

* Ensure HR compliance with ISO standards, SOC 2 controls, and other regulatory/audit requirements
* Prepare and maintain audit documentation, evidence registers, and compliance trackers.
* Coordinate and support internal and external audits; ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Work closely with InfoSec, Legal, and Management teams to ensure governance alignment.

4\. **Performance Management System (PMS):**

* Drive and manage the Performance Management process, including goal setting, reviews, appraisals, and feedback cycles.
* Ensure fair, transparent, and consistent performance evaluation practices.
* Support managers in performance discussions, improvement plans, and capability development.
* Track performance metrics and provide actionable insights to leadership.

5\. **Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution:**

* Act as a trusted partner for employees and managers to address workplace concerns.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and conflict resolution with sensitivity and fairness.
* Ensure adherence to disciplinary processes, corrective actions, and documentation standards.
* Foster a positive and respectful work environment

6\. **Culture Building \& Employee Engagement:**

* Drive initiatives that strengthen organizational culture, values, and employee engagement.
* Promote collaboration, transparency, and ownership across teams.
* Support leadership in embedding cultural values into daily operations and people practices.
* Design and execute engagement initiatives aligned with company culture and growth goals.

7\. **Talent Acquisition Oversight:**

* Oversee recruitment strategy, workforce planning, and hiring timelines.
* Guide recruiters on role requirements, interview frameworks, and hiring quality.
* Participate in final interviews for key positions and provide decision support.
* Monitor hiring metrics and continuously improve recruitment effectiveness.

8\. **HR Technology, AI \& Automation:**

* Leverage HRMS platforms, AI tools, and HR chatbots to streamline HR operations and employee support.
* Implement automation for onboarding, policy dissemination, employee queries, and reporting.
* Identify opportunities to enhance HR efficiency through technology and digital tools.

**Skills \& Competencies Functional \& Technical Skills:**

* Strong expertise in HR operations, compliance, audits, and governance.
* Practical exposure to ISO, SOC 2, and compliance\-driven environments.
* Ability to design and enforce policies, SOPs, and internal regulations.
* Proficiency in HRMS, AI tools, and chatbot\-enabled HR operations.
* Excellent documentation and process orientation.

**Soft Skills \& Behavioral Competencies:**

* Exceptional attention to detail with a strong compliance mindset.
* Quick action and problem\-solving abilities in operational scenarios.
* Strong conflict resolution and employee handling skills.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Project Engineer (Execution \& Site Support)**

Job Title: Project Engineer – Site Execution \& Systems Support

Location: Village Majara (8km for Ahmedgarh), dist. Ludhiana, Punjab (full\-time on\-site)

Reporting To: Senior Project Engineer

Experience: 2–5 years (fresher with strong internship/project experience in industrial construction will be considered)

Joining: By May 2026

**About the Company \& Project**

Carbon Secure India Pvt. Ltd. (CSI) is a fast\-growing climate\-tech startup building a large\-scale biochar carbon removal project on a 60 acre site.

Using paddy straw and rice husk as feed stock, we operate artisanal kilns scaled to industrial levels in Ludhiana, Punjab. Carbon will ultimately be sequestered through innovative burial of biochar in underground vertical silos for durable, high\-integrity credits. Initially, biochar will be used by local farmers at nominal charge for soil amendment.

Commercial production commences in May 2026, with a targeted scale\-up to 10 MT of biochar per day by year\-end. We aim to forward\-sell carbon credits from June 2026 and achieve first issuances by September 2026\.

We are now enhancing our infrastructure with vertical refractory brick kilns equipped with real\-time sensing, syngas\-fed rotary dryers for paddy straw pre\-treatment, and a 12 MW syngas cogeneration unit to improve efficiency, consistency, and energy self\-sufficiency.

**Role Overview**

You will provide hands\-on execution support to the Senior Project Engineer, focusing on day\-to\-day site supervision, coordination, documentation, and real\-time data collection during construction and commissioning of the kilns, dryers, and cogeneration unit.

**Key Responsibilities** 

Supervise daily construction and installation activities at site (refractory brick laying for vertical kilns, rotary dryer assembly, syngas piping, and 12 MW cogeneration setup).

Coordinate with contractors and vendors for material receipt, installation, and quality checks.

Install, calibrate, and maintain real\-time sensing systems (temperature probes, gas analysers, flow meters, pressure sensors) across all equipment and feed live data to the central monitoring dashboard.

Support testing and commissioning of syngas\-fed rotary dryers and the cogeneration unit (including safety interlocks and performance trials).

Maintain detailed site records, daily progress reports, punch lists, as\-built drawings, and safety logs.

Assist in procurement follow\-up, inventory management of refractory materials, piping, and instrumentation.

Work closely with the Ludhiana Junior Sustainability Coordinator to ensure all sensing data feeds into the MRV system from day one.

Troubleshoot day\-to\-day site issues and escalate promptly to the Senior Project Engineer.

**Requirements** 

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering.

2–5 years (or strong relevant internships) in industrial project execution, preferably involving kilns, dryers, thermal systems, or power generation.

Practical knowledge of sensors, instrumentation, and basic PLC/SCADA systems.

Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Project/Excel, and site documentation.

Willingness to work long hours on\-site in a dusty, hot industrial environment.

Good Hindi/Punjabi communication skills for contractor coordination.

**Compensation** 

Base: ₹8 – 14 lakhs per annum

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a responsible and organized **Material Coordinator** to manage material procurement, stock monitoring, and logistics coordination for multiple project sites. The candidate will ensure timely availability of materials, maintain proper stock records, coordinate transportation, and support smooth site operations by managing tools, equipment, and inventory efficiently.

· **Tools \& Equipment Management**  
Maintain records of **tools, machinery, and equipment** used at project sites, including their availability, condition, and movement.

· **Data \& Reporting**  
Maintain proper documentation and reports related to **material movement, stock status, tools inventory, and site requirements**.

· **Labour Data Maintenance**  
Maintain proper records of labour deployed at project sites, including attendance, contractor details, and manpower strength. Coordinate with site supervisors to update labour data regularly and maintain accurate reports.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

**Yantra 24x7\- Profimax Digiconnect Private Limited** is the flagship Smart Factory 4\.0 product of Profimax Digiconnect Private Limited, headquartered in Saibaba Colony,Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. We build Industrial IoT solutions that digitize CNC machine shops — giving manufacturers real\-time visibility into production, downtime, quality, and machine health.

Our platform — Yantra 24x7 — delivers measurable impact: 20–30% improvement in production efficiency, significant reduction in downtime, and payback in under 3 months. Trusted by 150\+ companies across Defence, Automotive, Aerospace, Medical Devices, Electronics, and Pumps \& Valves industries across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and beyond.

We are now executing a structured expansion plan across Tamil Nadu and Bangalore — and we are hiring 5 Field Sales Engineers (Freshers) to build this ground team and drive our next phase of growth.

This is a ground\-floor opportunity to join a fast\-growing IoT company and become the face of Yantra 24x7 in your territory. You will be one of the first 5 Field Sales Engineers building a brand\-new sales motion — from identifying prospects in CNC machine shops to running product demonstrations, activating pilots, and converting them to paying customers.

This is not a passive inside\-sales role. You will be on the field every day — visiting industrial estates, talking to shop floor owners and production managers, and solving real manufacturing problems with technology. If you are hungry, self\-driven, and excited about Industry 4\.0 and manufacturing — this role is designed for you.

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing, Electrical, or Electronics Engineering — 2023, 2024, or 2025 graduates.

**Experience**

**Knowledge \& Skills**

title: Automation Testing Business Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
***hackajob**

**Description**
 You will collaborate closely with developers, product owners, designers, and other stakeholders to refine requirements, validate functionality, and introduce QA processes that uplift the team’s overall delivery quality. This position is ideal for someone who excels in dynamic environments, is comfortable wearing multiple hats, and can help build structure where formal QA processes are still maturing.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and user story creation.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to define project scope, goals, and acceptance criteria.
* Translate high‑level business needs into detailed Jira stories, tasks, and defects.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, and UI/UX teams to clarify requirements and resolve inconsistencies early in the sprint cycle.
* Ensure delivered solutions meet documented business needs and functional specifications.
* Design and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts to achieve comprehensive coverage of system functionality.
* Identify, document, and track defects using Jira, and collaborate with developers to validate fixes.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end‑to‑end testing to ensure product stability.
* Develop, execute, or maintain automation test scripts using JavaScript/TypeScript as needed.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in partnership with the engineering team.
* Analyze test results and produce clear, detailed reports for stakeholders.
* Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT), including support, training, and documentation for end users.
* Communicate progress, risks, blockers, and quality concerns effectively to project stakeholders.
* Continuously refine test processes, frameworks, and coverage to improve efficiency and overall product quality.
* Provide QA sign‑off for releases and maintain documentation for test results, processes, and standards.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience in QA, Business Analysis, or a hybrid QA‑BA role.
* Strong ability to translate business requirements into clear, detailed Jira stories, tasks, and acceptance criteria.
* Hands‑on experience with software testing of scalable web applications, including functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Familiarity with UI/web automation tools such as Selenium WebDriver or Playwright.
* Hands‑on experience using Zephyr for Jira to manage test cases, test cycles, and execution.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with careful attention to detail.
* Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering high‑quality work.
* Excellent communication skills, with ability to work effectively across technical and non‑technical teams.
* Ability to adapt to evolving priorities, learn quickly, and work independently with minimal supervision.

description:
**Job Description: Human Resources (HR) Executive**

**About Chhanv Foundation**

Chhanv Foundation is an NGO committed to the rehabilitation, empowerment, and advocacy of acid attack survivors. Through initiatives like Sheroes Hangout Cafés and various survivor\-led programs, the organization fosters dignity, inclusion, and meaningful livelihood opportunities. The HR Executive will play a key role in ensuring fair, empathetic, and efficient human resource practices across all units.

**Position:** HR Executive

**Location:** Noida  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Job Summary**

The HR Executive will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end HR operations, supporting the implementation of HR systems, and maintaining strong internal communication with team members and survivors. This role requires an empathetic, detail\-oriented, and proactive individual who can balance administrative responsibilities with effective people management.

**Core Responsibilities HR Operations \& Systems**

* Support and carry out activities related to the ongoing implementation of new HR systems and digital tools.
* Manage and update employee records, attendance, contracts, and HR documentation.
* Prepare and coordinate documentation and processes related to all types of leave.
* Monitor the leave status of associates, track compensation during leaves of absence, and facilitate smooth return\-to\-work transitions.

**Employee Relations \& Survivor Support**

* Serve as the initial point of contact for HR\-related matters and provide guidance to employees.
* Co\-manage and serve as the main point of contact for all communication activities involving survivors.
* Maintain strong internal relationships with survivors and assist them with challenges, inquiries, and benefits as per organizational policies.
* Facilitate grievance redressal by listening to concerns and escalating matters appropriately.
* Ensure a trauma\-informed, supportive, and inclusive work environment.

**Policy, Compliance \& Coordination**

* Work closely with senior management to create, review, and revise HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure compliance with organizational HR policies and applicable statutory requirements such as PF, ESI, and labor laws.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for timely payroll inputs including attendance, overtime, and deductions.
* Draft HR letters, memos, notices, and internal communication as required.

**Recruitment, Onboarding \& Training**

* Support end\-to\-end recruitment activities including job postings, screening, interviews, and documentation.
* Facilitate onboarding, induction, and orientation programs for new employees and interns.
* Support training and development initiatives, including workshops and skill\-building programs for associates and survivors.

**Reporting \& Communication**

* Produce reports, graphs, charts, and required documents for the HR department.
* Prepare and compile data for monthly departmental reports for senior management and the board of directors.
* Collaborate effectively with internal teams and maintain open communication with senior leadership to ensure alignment on HR objectives.

**Employee Engagement \& Culture**

* Assist in planning and executing employee engagement activities, events, and welfare programs.
* Help build a positive, respectful, and growth\-oriented work culture aligned with the mission of survivor empowerment.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Management, Psychology, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of HR experience (NGO experience preferred).
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Empathy, patience, and the ability to work in a trauma\-informed environment.

**Remuneration**

* Salary range: **₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month**, based on experience.
* Additional benefits as per organizational policy.

title: Head - GEEC
description:
***Be the First to Apply***

Job Description


Head \- GEECThe Head of GEEC provides strategic leadership for global HR operations, delivering a seamless, compliant, and employee\-centric service model across the organization. The role oversees end\-to\-end employee lifecycle services, global payroll governance, statutory compliance, annual reporting, audit readiness, and HR data integrity across geographies. The incumbent drives service excellence through strong case management, self\-service and chatbot enablement, and continuous process improvement. By identifying automation and optimization opportunities and partnering with HR Technology for solution design and adoption (including Workday enhancements), the role advances digital transformation across HR operations.
**KEY STAKEHOLDERS: INTERNAL**

• HR Leadership Team, HR Business teams globally, HR COEs
• Functional Leaders
• Internal auditors
**KEY STAKEHOLDERS: EXTERNAL**

• Outsourcing Partners and Service Providers
• Industry Bodies and Compliance Authorities
• Statutory auditors
**REPORTING STRUCTURE:**

The position reports to the Chief Human Resource Officer, PPL. Team size \- \~20 employees, including 4 managers and associates across various workstreams within GEEC


**QUALIFICATION:**

• MBA in HR or equivalent postgraduate degree, Graduation in Science and Engg wil l be preferred
**EXPERIENCE:**

• 15\+ years of experience in HR, with 5\+ years in leadership roles.
• Exposure to end\-to\-end employee life cycle processes
• Experience in managing global HR operations, including hands\-on experience with any HRMS.
**CRITICAL QUALITIES:**

• Deep knowledge of end\-to\-end payroll, compliance, audits, HR data governance, and annual reporting.
• Strong focus on designing employee\-centric services, case management, and chatbot/self\-service solutions
• Advanced Excel, Eye for detail, reporting, and familiarity with HR systems to generate actionable insights.
• Process\-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy, standardization, continuous improvement, and scalable operations.
• Proven ability to build high\-performing teams, develop talent, drive change management, and implement digital/automation solutions in partnership with HR Technology.
**Employee Service \& Experience Excellence**

• Review and refine the GEEC strategy and roadmap in alignment with enterprise HR priorities and evolving business needs.
• Champion a best\-in\-class employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle (hire to retire).
• Design and implement scalable global service delivery models that are employee\-centric, responsive, and easy to navigate.
• Establish and monitor service metrics (SLAs, TAT, CSAT, NPS) to continuously enhance service quality.
• Strengthen self\-service capabilities, knowledge management frameworks, and communication channels to improve accessibility and transparency.
**HR Data Governance \& Reporting**

• Establish and maintain strong HR data governance standards, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality.
• Ensure data readiness for internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and compliance reviews.
• Oversee preparation and validation of annual HR reporting, statutory workforce disclosures, and compliance submissions.
• Strengthen data controls, documentation, and SOPs to support audit trails and reporting transparency.
• Drive data quality improvement initiatives in partnership with HRBPs and HR Technology teams.
• Identify and mitigate operational, compliance, and data privacy risks across HR processes, ensuring adherence to internal policies and regulatory frameworks.
**Process Excellence and Digital enablement:**

• Identify process improvement and automation opportunities across HR operations.
• Partner with HR Leadership to continuously evolve the HR operating model, optimizing centralization, automation, and service effectiveness
• Define business requirements and partner with the HR Technology team to design appropriate system solutions (including HRMS optimization).
• Collaborate closely with HR Tech on implementation, testing, change management, and adoption of new tools and enhancements.
• Drive the effective deployment of case management platforms and AI\-enabled solutions (e.g., HR chatbots) to enhance self\-service and reduce manual effort.
• Establish governance mechanisms and operating rhythms to ensure consistent and efficient service delivery across geographies and businesses.
**Global Payroll Leadership \& Compliance**

• Own end\-to\-end payroll governance (Currently India), ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing.
• Lead the strategic consolidation of payroll operations across geographies, transitioning country\-managed payroll processes into a centralized, standardized, and well\-governed global payroll model.
• Ensure compliance with local statutory regulations, tax laws, labor laws, and global corporate policies including meeting with statutory bodies wherever required.
• Oversee payroll reconciliations, variance analysis, payroll funding, provisioning, statutory disclosures and financial controls in partnership with Finance.
• Ensure timely statutory filings, year\-end payroll activities, and annual reporting requirements.
• Manage payroll audits (internal and external), respond to auditor queries, and ensure timely remediation of findings.
**Team Leadership \& Development**

• Build and lead a high\-performing, service\-oriented GEEC team.
• Develop internal talent pipelines and strengthen succession planning.
• Enhance team capabilities through cross\-skilling, upskilling, and leadership development.
• Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, compliance discipline, and continuous improvement.
**Vendor \& Partner Governance**

• Manage relationships with external payroll, HR services vendors, ensuring service quality, cost efficiency, and contractual compliance.
• Establish performance metrics and governance mechanisms to monitor vendor delivery and drive continuous improvement.

**What would you do?** Act as a subject matter expert for the unit Accountable for the delivery of contracted services within the assigned service line. Must have clear understanding of the existing metrics in the process, how they are measured and improvise the measurement system to make it more effective and transparent. Detailed understanding of Process metrics e.g. SLA, OLA, KPI. Manage the deal Budget effectively. Participate in the establishment and development of the Operations, leveraging previous (HR outsourcing) experience in order to provide a differentiated service to the client Ensure delivery of non\-commercial aspects of the outsourcing agreement, as well as standards of service (relating to quality, effectiveness, productivity, efficiency etc.) Initiate, design and implement business process excellence improvements Demonstrate, and seeks to deepen, an awareness of business / industry issues and drivers Design and implement the procedures and principles for daily operations across the service line leveraging previous HR outsourcing experience to provide a differentiated service to the client • Make decisions to improve the operation of the assigned service line and contributes to the advancement of the clients and Accenture s business. Provide solutions to complex business problems within the service line. Establish and maintain key relationships with the client, team leads and client management. Comply with all Client and Accenture Data Security/ Data Protection and Quality requirements. Implement the necessary reporting and governance arrangements to ensure effective management controls are established to oversee effective and efficient operation of the service line. Acts as the escalation point for problems/issues within the service line. Ensure right staffing levels within the service line to deliver business results. Identify and implement procedural \& policy improvements on an ongoing basis to improve the operation of the assigned service line \& contribute to the advancement of the clients \& Accenture s business Drives activities to meet requirements (e.g., timelines, quality, and costs) \& does whatever is needed to complete the task on time and error free. Raises relevant quality and/ or scope issues which may impact delivery and streamlines decision\-making processes where possible. Liaise with Service Management Team on reporting performance measures to the Client.  

**What are we looking for?** Hand\-on Knowledge of HRMS (SAP, Workday, Oracle) is required • Excellent interpersonal skills \- can build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels • Self driven • Strong customer orientation \- high level of responsiveness to urgent requests or troubleshooting. • Advanced leadership and coaching skills • Resilient and able to work under pressure • Good organizational, prioritization and multi\-tasking skills in order to deliver to deadlines • Continuous improvement mindset • Demonstrate high levels of confidentiality • Team Work \& collaboration • Excellent Team Management Skills • Excellent communication \& Customer Service skills • Strong MS Office and Excel skills
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of moderately complex problems • Typically creates new solutions, leveraging and, where needed, adapting existing methods and procedures • The person requires understanding of the strategic direction set by senior management as it relates to team goals • Primary upward interaction is with direct supervisor or team leads • Generally interacts with peers and/or management levels at a client and/or within Accenture • The person should require minimal guidance when determining methods and procedures on new assignments • Decisions often impact the team in which they reside and occasionally impact other teams • Individual would manage medium\-small sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts


  

Any Graduation

**Skill required:** Pharmacovigilance Operations \- Pharmacovigilance \& Drug Safety Surveillance  

**Designation:** Pharmacovigilance Services Assoc Manager  

**Qualifications:**Bachelor of Pharmacy/BSc. Nursing
  

**Years of Experience:**10 to 14 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** Staff Management \& Development • Recruit, hire and reward high performing individuals to meet goals. Facilitate resource evaluation needs across sites. • Ensure team members receive the necessary training to perform their job functions effectively and consistently within regulations. • Manage both internal and external stakeholders ensuring the challenges are tackled efficiently Process \& Technology • Understand and work to the current divisional/departmental SOPs, ensuring deviations are documented appropriately. Propose new and revise current procedures as appropriate. • Lead and work with the teams to optimize processes and use of pharmacovigilance\-related technology to build a more efficient organization. Encourage practical applications of new ideas. • Formulate decisions and prioritize implementation of enhancements. Client Management • Ensure adherence to client’s policies and procedures. • Maintain procedures in adherence to the client’s policies. • Ensure all the client SLAs and KPIs are met. • Assist in audit and inspections. • Ensure all relevant governance documents (slides and minutes) are archived in the respective folders • Other essential duties include drafting pharmacovigilance agendas and meeting minutes; accurately archiving pharmacovigilance documents; reviewing safety case data and other pharmacovigilance documents for completeness and accuracy.  

**What are we looking for?** Educational and Experience Requirements: • Graduate in life sciences. • Good understanding of Patient/Drug safety, Individual Case Safety Reports and Global Regulatory requirements. • Creative approach to problem solving and good lateral thinking skills. • High energy and drive to lead large teams. • Comfortable working in a dynamic business environment • Sound Communication Skills and Analytical Ability. • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. • Ability to work independently under tight time constraints Tracking, submitting and distributing of reports; trouble shoot issues if any; assisting liaisons with the partners and cross\-functional team members to ensure compliance; supporting various ad\-hoc deliverables or pharmacovigilance projects; and participating in audits and inspections. • To perform assist and contribute to transition related activities as per the client requirement. • To perform TMF review and update. • To provide relevant approval as per SOP/SWI • To perform compliance related quality check, monthly review of Literature articles as per the guidance document • To monitor, review and reconcile client tool/databases and identify if any discrepancy noted/noticed and troubleshoot the same. • To request relevant access, tool, databases, Software Applications etc. as applicable • Monitoring, tracking and reconciliation of client mailboxes and SharePoint as applicable. • Coordinate, and contribute in the Product/Study configuration process
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** Resource management • Coordination and Supervision \- Coordinate, manage and monitor workings of various processes in the organization, including but not limited to translations, tool/system access requests, Product/Study configurations, Literature Full text approvals, Query management, case deletion approvals. • Best Practices \- Improve processes and policies in support of organizational goals. Monitor adherence to rules, regulations and procedures. • Perform the literature QC lead activities as outlined in the Client SOP. • Monitor submission gap reports and coordinate with Global case processing associate to complete the pending case submissions as per Client SOP. • Production \- Coordinate and monitor the work of various sections involved in production, monitor performance, and implement improvements. Provide technical support where necessary. • Facilitate coordination and communication between support functions. • Strategic Input \- Liaison with senior management. Assist in the development of strategic plans for operational activity. Implement and manage operational plans. • Work with HR and recruitment to ensure timely mobilization of manpower (including definition of JDs and selection of candidates). • Planning, allocation, and reconciliation on the day\-to\-day activities in the project • Ensure adherence to output targets at desired quality levels. • Analyze MIS and take corrective action where required. • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts


  

Bachelor of Pharmacy,BSc. Nursing

title: Sr. D&T Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
:

India is among the top ten priority markets for General Mills, and hosts our Global Shared Services Centre. This is the Global Shared Services arm of General Mills Inc., which supports its operations worldwide. With over 1,300 employees in Mumbai, the center has capabilities in the areas of Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Digital and Technology, Sales Capabilities, Consumer Insights, ITQ (R\&D \& Quality), and Enterprise Business Services. Position Title  

Sr D\&T Analyst, Supply Chain

Digital \& Technology  

Location  

Mumbai

11 am to 8 pm

D\&T Manager E2E Supply chain (End to End)  

Remote/Hybrid/in\-Office  

Hybrid  

**ABOUT GENERAL MILLS**

 **We make food the world loves: 100 brands. In 100 countries. Across six continents.** With iconic brands like Cheerios, Pillsbury, Betty Crocker, Nature Valley, and Häagen\-Dazs, we’ve been serving up food the world loves for 155 years (and counting). Each of our brands has a unique story to tell.


How we make our food is as important as the food we make. Our values are baked into our legacy and continue to accelerate


us into the future as an innovative force for good. General Mills was founded in 1866 when Cadwallader Washburn boldly bought the largest flour mill west of the Mississippi. That pioneering spirit lives on today through our leadership team who upholds a vision of relentless innovation while being a force for good. For more details check out http://www.generalmills.com

  

General Mills India Center (GIC) is our global capability center in Mumbai that works as an extension of our global organization delivering business value, service excellence and growth, while standing for good for our planet and people.


With our team of 1800\+ professionals, we deliver superior value across the areas of Supply chain (SC) , Digital \& Technology (D\&T) Innovation, Technology \& Quality (ITQ), Consumer and Market Intelligence (CMI), Sales Strategy \& Intelligence (SSI) , Global Shared Services (GSS) , Finance Shared Services (FSS) and Human Resources Shared Services (HRSS).For more details check out https://www.generalmills.co.in


We advocate for advancing equity and inclusion to create more equitable workplaces and a better tomorrow.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

 **Function Overview**

  

The Digital and Technology team at General Mills stands as the largest and foremost unit, dedicated to exploring the latest trends and innovations in technology while leading the adoption of cutting\-edge technologies across the organization. Collaborating closely with global business teams, the focus is on understanding business models and identifying opportunities to leverage technology for increased efficiency and disruption. The team's expertise spans a wide range of areas, including AI/ML, Data Science, IoT, NLP, Cloud, Infrastructure, RPA and Automation, Digital Transformation, Cyber Security, Blockchain, SAP S4 HANA and Enterprise Architecture. The MillsWorks initiative embodies an agile@scale delivery model, where business and technology teams operate cohesively in pods with a unified mission to deliver value for the company. Employees working on significant technology projects are recognized as Digital Transformation change agents.

  



The team places a strong emphasis on service partnerships and employee engagement with a commitment to advancing equity and supporting communities. In fostering an inclusive culture, the team values individuals passionate about learning and growing with technology, exemplified by the "Work with Heart" philosophy, emphasizing results over facetime. Those intrigued by the prospect of contributing to the digital transformation journey of a Fortune 500 company are encouraged to explore more details about the function through the following Link

 **Purpose of the role**

  

This is an exciting time to be part of General Mills’ Solutions Delivery organization!

  

We are accelerating the Digital Transformation of Supply Chain business processes to drive smarter, faster, and value\-focused decisions. To support this mission, we are looking for a Sr D\&T Analyst with a passion for process optimization, data enablement, and metric automation to join our D\&T Supply Chain Business Process Management (BPM) Solutions Delivery team.

  

The BPM D\&T team works in close partnership with business stakeholders to build scalable data foundations, deliver automated and trusted metrics, and enable decision support capabilities across key process areas like LCF (Logistics, Customer \& Order Fulfillment) and MaKE (Manufacturing \& E2E Enablement). We leverage platforms like GCP, Alation, Azure DevOps, Palantir Foundry and custom\-built BPM portals (.net Based) to operationalize insights and create visibility into the health of our supply chain processes.

  

Key focus areas for this role include:


Providing technical consultation on the tools, platforms, and cloud\-based data pipelines that enable BPM metric automation and governance. Acting as a champion and enabler for data\-driven process decisions through BPM Portals, metric nodes, and stakeholder training. Leading metric development, from user story creation to deployment and training, while ensuring alignment to GMI’s Digital Supply Chain vision.

 **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Drive BPM initiatives across and perform Run and Improve tasks in the role of a data analyst in key supply chain processes (LCF/MaKE) by enabling automated, accurate, and scalable performance metrics
* Serve as the technical SME for BPM digital tools, portals, and metric repositories; provide insights and recommendations to drive decision\-making across Supply Chain operations
* Define and manage user stories in Azure DevOps (ADO); translate business requirements into technical solutions aligned with GMI’s Digital Supply Chain goals
* Lead development and implementation of metric nodes, process documents, and user training in the BPM Portal for end\-to\-end metric visibility as a D\&T analyst
* Drive projects along Supply Chain business processes; Work with SAP teams, ML engineers in the Product Platform model. Lead the team with deep knowledge into Planning and Deployment Supply chain areas
* Partner with cross\-functional PODs to proactively identify metric gaps, process constraints, and opportunities for automation and simplification
* Collaborate with data governance teams to align on metric definitions, data sources, and lineage documentation using tools like Alation and Collibra
* Act as the primary liaison between BPM business stakeholders and D\&T architects to ensure alignment on data models
* Participate in Agile PODs and drive delivery cadence with cross\-functional teams.
 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Education: Full\-time Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in technology delivery, with 7\+ years in supply chain systems with strong data foundation.
* Strong hands\-on experience in data engineering preferably within large\-scale CPG/FMCG environments.
* Working knowledge of GCP cloud and Proficiency in SQL, Python
* Experience using BPM portals, Azure DevOps, or similar tools to manage user stories, backlog, and metric delivery life cycle.
* Solid understanding of casefill, demand forecast accuracy, and other core supply chain metrics, with ability to translate them into automated KPIs.
* Familiarity with data governance practices, and tools such as Alation, Collibra, or equivalent for metric lineage and documentation.
* Proven ability to work cross\-functionally with business users, technical architects, and analytics teams to co\-develop solutions and drive adoption.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and process\-thinking skills, with ability to operate in Agile, POD\-based delivery environments.
* Highly collaborative, self\-directed, and committed to driving clarity in complex, data\-driven transformation initiatives.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Proven experience supporting Business Process Management (BPM) or Continuous Improvement functions through data and reporting.
* Experience in or Knowledge of Palantir Foundry capabilities
	+ Data Integration and Harmonization – Database connectivity, APIs, Cloud Storage, Data Cleansing
	+ Advanced Analytics and Visualization\- perform complex queries, build data models, and derive actionable insights through interactive dashboards, low\-code tools, and visualization components.
	+ Operational Decision making – tools/reports/dashboard for complex operational decision making
* Strong working knowledge of SQL, BigQuery, and Python for data wrangling, cleaning, and automation of recurring metrics.
* Strong working knowledge metric automation, and BPM enablemen
* Hands\-on experience creating trusted, automated dashboards using tools like Tableau, Google Data Studio, Power BI, or Looker.
* Familiarity with Alation, Collibra, or other data cataloging/governance tools to ensure lineage, definition, and trust in reported metrics.
* Ability to translate complex supply chain processes (e.g., LCF, MaKE) into structured, repeatable metric frameworks.
* Understanding of key supply chain performance metrics: forecast accuracy, casefill, inventory health, OTIF, etc.
* Experience working in Agile PODs, including managing sprint deliverables and backlog in Azure DevOps or JIRA.
* Exposure to cloud data ecosystems like Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and working with data in production\-level pipelines.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate data\-driven insights and support change enablement across diverse business teams.
* Curiosity\-driven and self\-starter mindset with the ability to operate independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

  


Company Overview:

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one other and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
HR Coordinator
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Recruitment \& Onboarding**

* Coordinate and schedule interviews with candidates and hiring teams.
* Manage job postings across external job boards and internal platforms.
* Maintain and update the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and track candidate progress.
* Screen resumes for basic qualifications and route candidates appropriately.
* Communicate interview details, status updates, and document requirements to candidates.
* Manage offer approval workflows and prepare offer letters.
* Initiate and monitor background checks, reference checks, and medical checks.
* Collect, verify, and file new hire documents in Workday for localized and non‑localized hires.
* Share new hire details with CRES and IT for workspace, systems access, and equipment setup.
* Send welcome emails and support onboarding coordination.
* Maintain the New Hire Tracker and ensure accurate completion of Workday onboarding tasks.
* Support IRG activities and assist with recruitment events or career fairs as needed.

**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.  

  



http://www.syneoshealth.com

title: Recruiter
description:
**Description**  

**Corporate Recruiter**  

The Recruiter drives the identification and attraction of talent through strategic marketing, diversity outreach, passive recruiting, and social media. Previous Call Center experience a PLUS

**In this role you will:*** Lead the talent acquisition process from requisition approval through new hire on\-boarding.
* Establish and maintain relationships with key decision\-makers within the departments to ensure full understanding of business unit goals, initiatives, and challenges, in order, to align the talent acquisition strategy to the needs of the business.
* Use passive and direct sourcing techniques and seeks new methods and innovative solutions to identify and attract prospective candidates and build pipeline.
* Leverage in\-house recruitment efforts and online recruiting resources to examine and hire ideal candidates.
* Manage the selection, presentation, closing, negotiation, offer, and administrative components for new hires.
* Maintain well\-ordered and accurate documentation on all candidates.
* Use social and professional networking sites to identify and source candidates.
* Function as the primary point of contact and coordinate appropriately with all parties involved in the process.
* Manage all required pre\-screenings and ensure assessment tools are utilized and consistent.
* Schedules and coordinate all hiring manager interviews.

**We are looking for someone who has:*** Bachelor’s in Human Resources or other related fields.
* 2\+ years of full life cycle/high volume recruiting experience.
* Demonstrated business acumen in understanding hiring managers needs and applying appropriate recommendations.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written.
* Excellent negotiation skills and effective organizational skills.
* The ability to thrive in a fast\-paced results\-oriented environment

**About ResultsCX:**  

ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. We design, build, and deliver digitally influenced customer journeys that achieve the satisfaction and loyalty brands need to thrive and grow, while improving efficiency and reducing costs. ResultsCX’s 30\+\-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI\-powered digital experience platform. Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high\-performing, fun culture to deliver next\-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.

**Qualifications:**Any Graduation
  

**Years of Experience:**1 to 3 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** • Data entry in HR1S and managing service request via Oracle Helpdesk. • Update HR1S systems, which include, but not limited to internal and client\-based applications with HR transactions • Double\-check all work before submission to ensure accuracy • Extract, Analyse and Deliver the output report to ensure data has been processed accurately • Must have clear understanding of the existing matrices in the process, how they are measured. e.g. SLA, KPI • Complete tasks within the assigned time frame (SLA) to ensure timely delivery • Communicate with the requestor via Helpdesk to receive accurate information to proceed with the service request • Reviews all input to ensure data is compliant with standard operation procedure practices • Escalate issues and seek advice when faced with complex issues/problems • Stick to established processes and guidelines like Localisation documents to ensure consistent, accurate results, leverage tools, checklists, or templates provided to ensure work is done correctly • Propose process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and controls contributing We Innovate Initiatives • Effective communication and teamwork abilities • Attention to detail and the ability to manage BAU • Act on feedback provided by supervisors or SMEs to improve your accuracy and efficiency moving forward • Complete Accenture and Client’s mandatory training but not limited to TQ, DQ, Ethics and Compliance, CTD and ensuring full adherence to developmental trainings • Ensuring accurate complete and timely reporting of data in Accenture and client tools as per requirements (ADRT, GPH, SQF, DMS, T\&E, etc.) • Collaborate with client Local People Partner (HRBP) for process clarification, updates or assistance • Proactively identify and mitigate process risks using prior HR experience. Escalate unmitigated risks to supervisors • Practice Root Cause Analysis on issues and recommend corrective and preventive actions to mitigate future occurrences. • Participate in Knowledge Transfer sessions to gain a solid understanding of processes and client\-specific initiatives, Business Transformation and developing expertise in key areas like Subject Matter Expert (SME)  

**What are we looking for?** Hand\-on Knowledge of HRMS (SAP, Workday, Oracle) is required •• 1\-3 years of experience in Human Resource Operations (HRO) with prior knowledge of HR processing • Hands on experience of managing work through workflow tool like Oracle • Should be proficient with MS Office Tools like Excel, Word, Outlook and Webmail • Must have excellent command over verbal and written English • Expertise in ensuring data privacy, security, and compliance with legal and client\-specific data protection standards • Maintain the highest level of confidentiality by strictly adhering to client data protection policies and legal standards, ensuring all sensitive information is securely handled. • Prioritizing tasks and managing time efficiently to handle multiple data\-related responsibilities. • Continuously seeking ways to enhance data management processes for greater efficiency and effectiveness. • Adjusting to new tools, technologies, and processes in a dynamic work environment. • Showcase technical proficiency by staying updated with the latest data management technologies and applying them to improve data workflows
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines • Your expected interactions are within your own team and direct supervisor • You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments • The decisions that you make would impact your own work • You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

**What would you do?** Meaningful Conversation: Being a People Lead, people conversations are essential for building trust, fostering development, and maintaining a positive team environment: • Roll\-On and Roll\-Off Coordinator: As the Roll\-On and Roll\-Off Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the seamless integration of new joiners (Roll\-On) and the smooth and secure transition for leavers (Roll\-Off) within the organization. This role ensures that both processes are carried out efficiently and in accordance with guidelines. • Performance Review: Performance review is essential for assessing and fostering team growth with proper communication which helps drive better meaning conversation and connectedness with the team members eam Engagement: Organize team outings to provide a break from the routine. Whether it s a fun activity or a team\-building exercise, outings allow team members to recharge and return to work with renewed energy and focus. Encourage a healthy work\-life balance by incorporating regular outings or social activities. These events promote mental well\-being, stress relief, and better work\-life integration • Retention and Alerts: Retention alerts and conversations are critical for identifying and addressing potential issues that could lead to team member turnover Work Allocation: Work allocation refers to distributing tasks or responsibilities fairly among team members, ensuring that work is completed on time and aligns with agreed SLAs. You will oversee workload distribution, ensure tasks are assigned effectively, and manage the overall performance of the team • Capacity Planning: Capacity planning ensures that the team has enough resources (time, skills, manpower) to meet the workload. You will need to estimate the team’s overall capacity and plan tasks to ensure they are achievable without overwhelming anyone

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of increasingly complex problems • Your day to day interactions are with peers within Accenture • You are likely to have some interaction with clients and/or Accenture management • You will be given minimal instruction on daily work/tasks and a moderate level of instruction on new assignments • Decisions that are made by you impact your own work and may impact the work of others • In this role you would be an individual contributor and/or oversee a small work effort and/or team • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts
