title: Internal Audit-Hyderabad-Analyst-Business Audit
description:
**Job Description**
 Internal Audit – Bengaluru – Analyst\- Enterprise Audit
   

  

 The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm that provides a wide range of financial services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals. Founded in 1869, the firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in all major financial centers around the world. We commit people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Our people are our greatest asset – we say it often and with good reason. It is only with the determination and dedication of our people that we can serve our clients, generate long\-term value for our shareholders and contribute to the broader public. We take pride in supporting each colleague both professionally and personally. From collaborative workspaces and ergonomic services to well\-being and resilience offerings, we offer our people the flexibility and support they need to reach their goals in and outside the office
   

  

 INTERNAL AUDIT
   

  

 In Internal Audit, we ensure that Goldman Sachs maintains effective controls by assessing the reliability of financial reports, monitoring the firm’s compliance with laws and regulations, and advising management on developing smart control solutions. Our group has unique insight on the financial industry and its products and operations. We’re looking for detail\-oriented team players who have an interest in financial markets and want to gain insight into the firm’s operations and control processes.
   

  

**What We Look For**
 Goldman Sachs Internal Auditors demonstrate strong risk and control mindsets, analytical, exercise professional skepticism and are able to challenge and discuss effectively with management on risks and control measures. We look for individuals who enjoy learning about audit, businesses and functions, have innovative and creative mindsets to adopt analytical techniques to enhance audit techniques, building relationships and are able to evolve and thrive in teamwork and in a fast\-paced global environment.
   

  

 YOUR IMPACT
   

  

 As The Third Line Of Defense, Internal Audit’s Mission Is To Independently Assess The Firm’s Internal Control Structure, Including The Firm’s Governance Processes And Controls, And Risk Management And Capital And Anti\-financial Crime Frameworks, Raise Awareness Of Control Risk And Monitor The Implementation Of Management’s Control Measures. In Doing So, Internal Audit
   

  

* Communicates and reports on the effectiveness of the firm’s governance, risk management and controls that mitigate current and evolving risk
* Raise awareness of control risk
* Assesses the firm’s control culture and conduct risks
* Monitors management’s implementation of control measures


 Goldman Sachs Internal Audit comprises individuals from diverse backgrounds including chartered accountants, developers, risk management professionals, cybersecurity professionals, and data scientists. We are organized into global teams comprising business and technology auditors to cover all the firm’s businesses and functions, including securities, investment banking, consumer and investment management, risk management, finance, cyber\-security and technology risk, and engineering.
   

  

 This position description is intended to describe the duties most frequently performed by an individual in this position. It is not intended to be a complete list of assigned duties but to describe a position level. The
   

  

 role shall be performed within a professional office environment. Goldman Sachs has health and safety polices that are available for all workers upon request. There are no specific health risks associate with the
   

  

 role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As an Sr Analyst/Associate, you will be responsible for execution of audit deliverables through effective time management, in accordance with the internal audit methodology of the department. You will assist the project manager in planning the scope of the audit, conduct walkthroughs and discussions with various teams to execute the audit scope and discuss results of the audit with the firms local and global management. You will play a vital role in execution of the audit scope, through succinct documentation and active engagement with various stakeholders focusing on analyzing the risks involved, assessing the design and operating effectiveness of the key controls implemented to mitigate the risk, in accordance with the internal audit methodology of the department. In addition, you will also monitor and follow up with management on the resolution of the open audit findings and maintain stakeholder relationship to monitor risk in their space. Job responsibilities also include assisting in the department’s continuous monitoring effort to cover operations incidents, market and regulatory events, business and technology updates. You are strongly encouraged to participate in department\-wide initiatives aimed at continually improving IA's processes and supporting infrastructure.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Chartered Accountant /Certified Financial Analyst /Masters in Business Administration specialized in Finance / Masters or equivalent University degrees in Accounting / Finance.
* CA fresher or 1 years of experience in risk\-based operations / process audits preferably focusing on areas such as human resources, accounts payable, procurement, third party risk management, and/or payment functions.
* Experience in executing audit engagements, with good judgement of risks and controls
* Strong technical skills required for the role with attention to detail, strong analytical skills and ability to translate the assimilated knowledge through effective documentation
* Experience in working in a team environment and adaptable to differential ways of working
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal skills, as the job requires frequent interaction with cross functional teams and stakeholders across the hierarchy within management
* Highly motivated with the ability to multi\-task and remain organized in a fast\-paced environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with data analytics tools and techniques
* Relevant certification or industry accreditation
* Capable of developing or implementing efficiency improvement or automated solutions that assist audit work

* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis

* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.

* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark

title: Network Engineer
description:
Join our forward\-thinking team as a Network Engineer, where you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting high\-performance, low\-latency network infrastructure.
   

  

 At IMC, the Trading Infrastructure team is responsible for the WAN, LANs, and all low\-latency connectivity to trading venues. You will work closely with Systems Engineers, internal teams, and external partners to deliver best\-in\-class solutions that support our trading business and help evolve our infrastructure to meet the demands of a dynamic industry.
   

  

**Your Core Responsibilities**
* Design, implement and support the networking infrastructure. Key areas include Low\-latency networking, Unicast and Multicast routing, OSPF, BGP, PIM SM, as well as things like QoS, STP, NAT, protocol tuning, etc.
* Monitor, guard and analyze the proper functioning of our network infrastructure. Take adaptive, retentive and corrective measures and perform structural maintenance.
* Proactively improve our infrastructure by contributing scripts and code to our automation efforts (e.g. Bash, Python).
* Accurately create and maintain documentation detailing the implemented network components, as well as relevant procedures and other documentation.
* Responsibility for our IT security related platforms. Key areas include Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, Security policies, etc.
* Work flexible hours. We are proud of the uptime of the trading environment, so every now and then you will be working outside of regular business hours to apply critical changes. This could be from your desk, your couch at home or also inside of one of our datacenters abroad.
* Liaise with external vendors, exchanges and providers to explore new technology solutions, implement new services or troubleshoot problems.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, with a passion for all aspects of networking
* Proven ability to design, implement, and support high\-performance networks
* Strong appetite for accuracy and willingness to go beyond standard textbook networking concepts
* Collaborative mindset with experience working closely across cross\-functional teams
* Ability to motivate and encourage peers while maintaining a high technical standard
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**About Us**
 IMC is a global trading firm powered by a cutting\-edge research environment and a world\-class technology backbone. Since 1989, we’ve been a stabilizing force in financial markets, providing essential liquidity upon which market participants depend. Across our offices in the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, and India, our talented quant researchers, engineers, traders, and business operations professionals are united by our uniquely collaborative, high\-performance culture, and our commitment to giving back. From entering dynamic new markets to embracing disruptive technologies, and from developing an innovative research environment to diversifying our trading strategies, we dare to continuously innovate and collaborate to succeed.

description:
**What you'll be doing:**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Patching and Updates
* Apply patches and updates to network devices, including firewalls, routers, switches, and load balancers.
* Conduct regular reviews to identify vulnerabilities in network configurations and implement timely fixes.
* Coordinate with vendors to stay current on firmware updates and security patches.
* Ticket Management and Task Execution
* Follow ticketing requests for patching and maintenance tasks
* Ensure all tasks align with assigned tickets, logging actions and maintaining communication with requestors for progress updates and task completion.
* Document outcomes and address any follow\-up actions as specified within the ticketing system to ensure traceability and accountability.
* Change Management and Compliance
* Adhere strictly to change management protocols, ensuring all changes are documented, approved, and scheduled to minimise disruption.
* Conduct pre\-implementation checks and gain approval with CAB before proceeding.
* Maintain meticulous change logs and provide reports for audit and compliance purposes.
* Risk Assessment and Impact Analysis
* Quantify and report on potential risks associated with patching activities
* Reference specific client topologies and configurations to assess and mitigate potential impact.
* Topology\-Specific Maintenance
* Refer to detailed network topology documentation to ensure all maintenance activities align with unique client environments and operational dependencies.
* Maintain familiarity with and documentation of client topologies, facilitating a streamlined, impact\-minimising approach to maintenance.
* Routine and Scheduled Maintenance
* Perform routine, scheduled patching and maintenance tasks as outlined in the iomart maintenance calendar, following strict adherence to procedures without deviation.
* Coordinate with client support and CAB to ensure maintenance windows are aligned with business needs and network performance expectations.
* Consistently document completed tasks and any observed issues during maintenance to support continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across the team.
* Ensure escalation to iomart on call colleagues in the event of a network issue or outage.
* Quality Reporting and Documentation
* Generate detailed reports on patching and maintenance activities, including compliance metrics and system performance.
* Maintain clear documentation for all network security policies, procedures, and configuration standards.
* Develop dashboards and visual reports to communicate network security status and trends to stakeholders.


**We want to hear from you if you:**
**Knowledge And Skills**
**Technical Proficiency**
* Extensive knowledge of network devices (e.g. Firewalls, routers, switches) and core network, switching and routing protocols.
* Extensive knowledge of network security protocols e.g. IPsec, SSL/TLS, SSH etc.
* Proficiency with network management, diagnostic and security tools, including vulnerability assessment software, and patch management platforms.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and standards, such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or ISO/IEC 27001\.


**Troubleshooting and Problem\-Solving**
* Ability to diagnose and resolve issues in complex network environments promptly.
* Experience in analysing network logs and employing root cause analysis to prevent recurring issues.
* Familiarity with SIEM solutions for proactive detection and mitigation of network vulnerabilities.


**Quality Reporting and Compliance**
* Proficiency in reporting tools and ability to capture pertinent information within reporting.
* Maintain accurate data within ticketing to ensure adequate reporting of activities and changes.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Certifications such as CCNA Security, CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Security\+, or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) are highly desirable.
* Experience \- At least 5 years in a network security or IT security role with hands\-on experience in patching, configuration, and monitoring of network devices.
* Education \- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Networks, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Additional Skills**
* Strong interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with other IT and cybersecurity professionals.
* Attention to detail, with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Proactive approach to cybersecurity, with a commitment to ongoing professional development.

* Food Provided
* Provident Fund
* Exam fee and training funding
* Healthcare Scheme.
* Enhanced maternity \& paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Employee Wellbeing policy
* Mobile reimbursement policy

 Atech part of the Iomart Group is a highly accredited Microsoft Partner who delivers transformed technology with managed services. Our team of certified Microsoft experts align with your team to deliver an excellent service tailored to your individual needs, 24/7/365\.

The HVAC Sales Executive is responsible for driving sales of commercial HVAC systems and projects by generating enquiries, preparing techno\-commercial proposals, coordinating with internal teams, and managing customer relationships from enquiry stage to order execution and payment collection.

* Address customer clarifications related to scope, specifications, and pricing in coordination with internal teams.

**Sales Order \& ERP Activities**

* Create and maintain customer master data in ERP systems as per company procedures.
* Ensure accuracy of commercial terms, scope, pricing, and delivery details in ERP sales orders.

**Client \& Internal Coordination**

* Act as a single point of contact between customers and internal departments such as design, estimation, procurement, production, accounts, and service teams.
* Coordinate with project execution teams for smooth handover of confirmed orders along with complete documentation.

**Payment Collection \& Accounts Coordination**

* Coordinate with the accounts department and customers to ensure timely collection of payments as per agreed credit terms.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and support resolution of billing or documentation issues.

**Market Intelligence \& Reporting**

* Track market trends, competitor activities, and pricing benchmarks in the HVAC industry.
* Prepare and submit periodic sales reports, MIS, forecasts, and pipeline status to management.

**Post\-Sales \& Relationship Management**

* Support customers during project execution for variations, additional scope, and commercial approvals.
* Ensure customer satisfaction and develop long\-term relationships for repeat business and referrals.

* Strong knowledge of commercial HVAC systems and project sales processes.

description:

***Who we are:***
 At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30\+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .

*Looking for* 
 technically skilled Technical Writer
   

  

**What you need:** 
 Technical Writer
   

  

**Jd**
**Technical Writer**
 Relevant exp\- 3\-5 Years
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* As a technical writer on our Technical Publication team, need to follow our style guides to create clear and concise information to help our customers. You will collaborate with fellow writers and internal business partners (such as GPS managers) to develop strategy and content. You will participate in content management efforts, process development, and quality governance in support of team success, while working independently on multiple projects.
* With new programs, products, and strategies being developed and launched all the time, the opportunities for imaginative and innovative thinking and content strategy are endless.
* This position will be in Bangalore.
* Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
* Independently working on Technical Writing projects: ensure the projects are completed on time, objectives are defined, necessary planning activities (e.g., plan authoring, review, estimation of deliverables, milestones, validating and testing, reliability, and risk mitigation of documents). Ensure project results meet requirements and also ensure technical accuracy, quality, reliability, and schedule.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for internal teams and business partners regarding editorial and quality control standards. Collaborate with the manager and others within the organization to plan required quality checks to ensure materials are up‐to‐date and revised as scheduled. Validate and manage processes to ensure material complies with standards and approval.
* Performs technical publications production duties using agile/ waterfall methodology: page composition and layout, illustration, and technical writing and editing. Develops clear written materials to support product development activities. Work cross‐functionally with SMEs to collect product information and specifications. Collects and organizes technical information and product images, and coordinates layout for publication. Adheres to established terminology, style and editorial quality standards.
* Work collaboratively and effectively with others to promote innovative approaches and enhance productivity related to quality material development.
* Report on document quality metrics/targets and collaborate with managers to analyze operational effectiveness to meet quality standards.
* Requires working closely with US based teams during US working hours.
* May need to work in second shift (1\-10 PM or 2\-11 PM) based on business requirement.


 May require 10% international travel.
   

  

**Qualifications And Education Requirements**
* Bachelor's Degree and certification in Technical writing, master’s Degree (preferred), and 3\-5 years working in a technical writing role with responsibility for end‐to‐end development of documentation for a technical audience.
* Must be able to prioritize and complete multiple tasks and follow through with team members to achieve group and individual goals.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented. Ability to build and maintain positive and productive inter‐departmental working relationships. Ability to influence team members and stakeholders on change management.
* Basic understanding of DITA/XML
* Have an understanding of technical certification methods for global audiences.
* Must be flexible and possess outstanding decision‐making skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills; ability to work cross\-functionally, maintain, and regularly update multiple project schedules.
* Must be a quick learner, self‐starter, and have the ability to work with minimal supervision in a fast‐paced, high‐tech environment.


**TOOL KNOWLEDGE**
* MS Word
* DITA/XML
* Adobe FrameMaker
* ArbotText Editor
* SnagIT
* MS PowerPoint


**Shift time\-** 
 General shift

*We’re proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we’ve been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. And today, it's those same values that are inspiring us to encourage innovation from everyone, to champion diversity and inclusion and to place people at the centre of everything we do.*

SuperProcure aims to revolutionize Indian logistics to save 1% of GDP spending and make India globally competitive, enabling collaboration on a single platform, and driving logistics efficiencies.

description:
**Skill required:** Talent Acquisition\- end to end \- Talent Identification  

**Designation:** Delivery Operations Team Lead  

**Qualifications:**Any Graduation
  

**Years of Experience:**7 to 11 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** US Recruitment Admin Lead to oversee and manage the recruitment administration team. This role is critical in ensuring the smooth execution of recruitment operations, maintaining compliance, and driving process improvements across the hiring lifecycle. The ideal candidate will bring leadership, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of US hiring practices. Recruitment Admin lead will be responsible for performing day to day task as per the recruitment process guidelines: 1\. Lead and mentor a team of recruitment administrators supporting US hiring operations. 2\.Oversee interview scheduling, offer management, background checks, and onboarding coordination. 3\. Ensure data accuracy and compliance within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Talent Acquisition \- End to End involves managing the entire recruitment process from start to finish. This includes identifying job needs, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, and making job offers. The goal is to efficiently fill positions with the best talent. Responsibilities also include onboarding new hires and ensuring a smooth transition into the company. This role is crucial for building a strong and effective workforce. Assess current and future talent needs, identify mission\-critical workforces, understand key workforce skills and competencies, and address talent gaps.  

**What are we looking for?** Excellent communication skills, Uses professional, error\-free grammar and formatting in emails Speaks with clarity, warmth, and confidence during virtual interactions. Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, and HR business partners to streamline administrative processes. Monitor and report on recruitment metrics and SLAs to ensure operational efficiency. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in recruitment workflows and documentation. Ensure adherence to US labor laws, EEO guidelines, and internal compliance standards. Manage vendor relationships related to background checks, job boards, and onboarding tools. Provide training and support to new team members and stakeholders on recruitment systems and processes.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of moderately complex problems • May create new solutions, leveraging and, where needed, adapting existing methods and procedures • The person would require understanding of the strategic direction set by senior management as it relates to team goals • Primary upward interaction is with direct supervisor • May interact with peers and/or management levels at a client and/or within Accenture • Guidance would be provided when determining methods and procedures on new assignments • Decisions made by you will often impact the team in which they reside • Individual would manage small teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts


  

Any Graduation

title: Mfg Asst Supervisor
description:
Overview:
* Ensuring support to manufacturing manager in meeting the production targets, SA along with optimum efficiencies.
* Co\-coordinating with manager in deciding the optimum capacity utilization across lines and SKU combinations for the shift based on the capacities and dispatch priorities \- communication the packaging leader of the plan and develop them working jointly to sustain key packaging deliverables in line with AOP.
* Ensuring minimal waste \+ rejects and maximum capacity utilization in shift.
* Ensuring smooth and efficient running of all lines and minimum downtime.
* Ensuring Zero debate BBS related best practices \& SOPs are followed by operators. No LTA/ fire incident in manufacturing.
* Why\-why analysis of all the process related issues and closing actions with Engineering within agreed timeline.
* Ensuring compliance of all the Key controls.
* Clearing AIB, safety, M\&W related audits with no NC in manufacturing.
* Ensuring all quality related parameters are met during production
* Ensuring timely information to Argo in case of potato related quality problems and Quality Dept. in case of any other quality related problems identified online and timely clearance of hold materials.
* Ensuring shop\-floor hygiene, food safety, product quality, packaging quality, TPM circles, Safety at the top during operation all the time
* Preparing the daily manpower plan for the permanent workers based on the production plan – preparing the shift roster and displaying it on the notice board.
* Preparing the manpower plan for contract workers daily balancing idle line capacity.
* Redeploying people based on competencies or gaps identified at a particular workstation to build the capability of people and line.
* Ensuring timely, accurate updating and maintenance of information related to department performance.
* Ensuring disruption free operation by addressing shop\-floor dispute of workers and don’t let such arguments to crop up as IR issues/unionized issues.
* Shop\-floor communications on various targets, opportunities area, market feedback, month’s targets, score cards etc. Motivating shop floor team, exploring R\&R sessions\& make the team participative to key agendas of plant.
* Ensure adherence to core PepsiCo processes like KP


Responsibilities:
**Safety*** Implement safety standards and drive safety culture.
* Participate in safety meetings and close the agreed recommendations within agreed timeline.
* Work with SHE pillar and safety coordinator on implementing the Safety related action points and working to ensure Zero LTA in the plant.
* Execute safety and sustainability capex and initiatives.

 **Sustainability*** Track, monitor and report sustainability KPIs \- EUR and WUR
* Drive sustainability agenda and take essential steps to achieve goals.
* Drive new sustainability project trials through continuous improvement

 **People Management*** Deployment of workmen on respective workstations as per plan
* driving the agenda for DL, developing backups on redeployment matrix to impact on manpower productivity. Regular coordination with HR on tracking unauthorized absenteeism and OT trend and ensuring effective communication to sustain good discipline.

**Production Deliverables*** Ensuring compliance to weekly/ monthly production targets as per PepsiCo quality and hygiene standards, delivering AVC over \& above AOP.
* Maximising TE/ NE , ensuring conversion efficiencies better than AOP and executing ideas on productivity.
* sharing views with sector SMEs for troubleshooting and capturing better productivity ideas implemented across other plants as a part of continuous improvement.
* Coordinating \& planning with cross functional team members to ensure seamless production.

 **Capacity Utilization*** Running the lines with best NE TE by monitoring \& reducing NE TE losses \& utilizing manpower planning in line with actual plan a capacity.

 **Waste Management*** Ensuring minimal wastage, recirculation ideas, optimum manpower utilization and operating at maximum efficiencies.
* Driving for “ZERO Loss” mantra for the lines with the help of sector team and by utilizing TPM tools \& ensuring cross functional involvement (focusing on JH culture on shop floor).

 **Planning and Reporting*** Ensuring integrity of data entry across lines, monitoring the data on shift to shift basis and reporting of the all the numbers on daily bases for the best control on the line.

 **IR Management*** Ensuring line discipline during production – OT, Absenteeism control, motivating the teams for the positive environment at the shop floor.
* Conducting 1\-1 with the operatives, conducting ZOZi sessions for the self and implementation of “Each one teach one”, “KPL” etc on the shop floor for the better engagement and building inclusive culture \& keeping the operation disruption free

 **Support to Cross function*** Enabling effective coordination with support functions \& implementation of a quality,
* hygiene, safety \& TPM culture that promotes company growth.
* Also ensuring the “Why Why Analysis” of b/d on timely manner. Need to ensure control on consumable cost.

 **SAP Management*** Batch closing and stock verification in Day store, taking care of GCS, SOX audit and KC compliances.
* Ensuring inventory management by proper transferring of FG and taking RM by proper hand shaking between the cross functional departments.

**NPD Handling*** Ensuring compliance to all NPD production, reference and Gold sample production on timely manner with AOP efficiency numbers.
* Ensuring proper feedback to R\&D to build upon the current standards.

 **Cost Management*** controlling the consumables, parts change management and developing new vendors for the reduction in consumables, better quality of parts at the engineering stores with close coordination with engineering team and engineering store person and sensitizing the shop floor team.

 **Acting as a reliever*** Relieving Shift In\-charges as and when required.

 **M\&W and other audit*** Acting as a manufacturing control owner/ representative of MNW data; quality \& safety audit.

 **New projects*** Acting as manufacturing representative for upcoming new projects.

 **Statutory Compliances*** Prepare statutory calendar and ensure implementation.
* Electricity act, The Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, The Legal Metrology Act, The Explosives Act, The Petroleum Act, The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, The Factories Act,

 **Learning*** Seeking feedback from seniors and peers
* Reflecting on own competencies and possible gaps
* Setting learning goals in consultation with seniors
* Monitoring implementation of these goals
* Continuously updating knowledge from outside environment
* Develop in\-depth understanding of MIS, VMOH, MOR etc.


Qualifications:
* BE/BTech in Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical / Food Technology with minimum 6\-8 years of experience in a FMCG / Food industry desirable.
* Sound Process \& equipment knowledge
* Improvement projects experience
* Experience of working in shifts
* Knowledge of manufacturing and packaging
* Good Communication and negotiation skills

description:
Job Description
**Job ID**
2601024
**Category**
HR
**Date posted**
04/09/2026  

  

**Role Title** **: AVP, Learning \& Development (L10\)****Company Overview**: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by Ambition Box Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities, focusing on Advancing Diverse Talent to take up leadership roles.

**Organizational Overview**:
This role will be part of the Synchrony Asia HR/L\&D team which is dedicated to fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth within the company. We work closely with various functions and leadership teams to identify organizational leadership learning needs and provide targeted solutions that align with business goals. In a dynamic and collaborative environment, we prioritize data\-driven decisions, evaluating the effectiveness of our leadership programs to ensure we are meeting both employee and organizational needs. The L\&D team plays a key role in shaping the company’s workforce and helping employees unlock their full potential.**Role Summary/Purpose**
In this role, you will have responsibility for the design, management, delivery, and ongoing evaluation of learning programs that help our employees advance their skills and knowledge, while identifying growth gaps. You will support plans to bridge these gaps by serving as a consultant on programs and programming driven by the Learning \& Development team. You will support ongoing development in line with current organizational needs by partnering with stakeholders and HR partners across all hubs (U.S., India and Philippines), as well as anticipating future development needs across all levels of the business. The role includes an Asia regional emphasis. You will facilitate training sessions locally and partner with local learning vendors to design, develop, and implement both global and locally relevant learning programs and courses.
The role requires strategic vision, critical thinking, and innovative approaches to elevate learning programs, strengthen leadership capability, and improve measurable outcomes.**Role Expectations**
The AVP, L\&D:* Has an acute sense of organizational goals and objectives, and designs and delivers learning experiences aligned to business priorities, including priorities across our Asia hubs.
* Has a strong understanding of portfolios and sub\-processes and their learning and development requirements, with the ability to translate global learning strategy into locally effective solutions for India and Philippines audiences.
* Adopts a global One Synchrony mindset in all learning and development initiatives, rooted in strategic thinking, including needs identification, design, delivery, support, vendor partnership, and curation that results in a holistic learning framework with strong adoption and impact in Asia hubs.

**Key Responsibilities*** Develop, design, and deploy Leadership Development programs and programming to ensure employees are equipped with competencies needed to be successful at work, including leadership learning design and facilitation of leadership programs for US and Asia hub audiences.
* Serve as a key learning partner for our Asia hubs by facilitating learning sessions locally (in\-person and virtual) and ensuring a consistent, high\-quality learner experience.
* Partner with local learning vendors in Asia hubs to design, develop, and implement global learning programs (localized as needed) and hub\-specific programs/courses aligned to business and cultural context.
* Implement learning needs identification and assessment tools (surveys, focus groups/brainstorming, one\-to\-one meetings) across hubs.
* Create, maintain and report Learning Dashboards for the L\&D team and function being serviced; effectively measuring impact of all learning interventions by monitoring the success of the programs enabling employees to make the most of learning opportunities and deliver value for the business.
* Create and maintain analytic rigor for learner audience (nominations, footfall, coverage, diversity, impact) with hub\-level tracking globally.
* Measure impact and demonstrable change from learning needs identification through post\-learning outcomes; apply insights to continuously improve learning effectiveness.
* Act as a lead, facilitate programs, and engage as a producer to support program delivery as per learning plans, including end\-to\-end facilitation readiness and delivery excellence.
* Identify and embrace multiple learning modalities (coaching, job\-shadowing, workshops, classroom, online) across in\-person, virtual, and hybrid environments to meet business/individual needs, including time\-zone and learner context considerations for global hubs.
* Establish and maintain effective relationships across all levels of the organization and functions/hubs with consistent stakeholder, Workforce Planning Ops and HR partner engagement, to provide relevant learning opportunities and strengthen adoption and reinforcement in day\-to\-day work.
* Develop and drive stakeholder assessments, learning plans, and projects that assist in facilitation of strategic learning goals.
* Build strong supplier relationships and support the supplier management lifecycle in partnership with the Sourcing and Supplier Management Team, including selection, governance, and performance management to deliver best\-fit content and solutions.
* Stay abreast of developments and challenges in driving a learning culture; bring insights to the L\&D team to develop strategies and focused interventions.
* Budget management, understanding of yearly allocation, proper utilization, and accountability, including budget considerations for Asia hub delivery and vendor partnerships.

**Required Skills/Knowledge*** Bachelor’s degree with 5\+ years’ experience in learning and development, or in lieu of a degree, 7\+ years of experience in learning and development.
* Minimum 2 years of learning, facilitation, instructional design and/or program management experience within/external to Synchrony, including demonstrated experience facilitating leadership programs.
* Demonstrated experience in leadership learning design (e.g., leadership curricula, manager development, cohort\-based experiences, blended solutions).
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills (virtual and in\-person).
* Strategic thinking proficiency, with demonstrated ability to translate strategy into scalable programs and measurable outcomes across global audiences.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities across global stakeholders and different time zones.
* Flexibility in work hours in support of hybrid and global environment.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Office applications, including Teams.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge*** Minimum 5\+ years demonstrated learning \& development leadership experience, including leadership program delivery and/or leadership capability building.
* Demonstrated ability to report data and analyze learning processes using reporting tools like Tableau / SAS BI (or similar) to drive improvements and recommendations.
* Ability to think and act strategically in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment; uses critical thinking and innovation to elevate learning outcomes.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities with little supervision in a virtual environment, while maintaining strong execution in Asia hubs.
* Strong in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Proven facilitation skills and experience delivering presentations and programs at various levels of the organization, including leadership audiences.
* Experience in project management and maintaining budgets.
* Experience in supplier management with strong communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to build strong relationships with supplier partners, including local vendor partnerships in Asia hubs.

**Eligibility criteria**
Bachelor’s degree with 5\+ years’ experience in learning and development, or in lieu of a degree, 7\+ years of experience in learning and development.**Work Timings:**This role is eligible for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally) on most days. This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may vary periodically due to business needs. Given the responsibilities and programs supported, this role will also require some flexibility with work timings. When there is a training program or learning session being conducted, the incumbent would be expected to flex their schedules to be available for the entire duration of the program.
Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.**For Internal Applicants**:* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.
* Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday.
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format).
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP).
* L8\+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible.
* L8 \+ Employees can apply.

As we embark on this unique journey, the firm is actively seeking to build a strong, capable team for the center. The GCC is growing rapidly and is already an 800\+ member team.

 **The Team**  

The team supports global operations and frequently collaborates with stakeholders across different regions and time zones, particularly Australia. Ensuring flexibility in work arrangements helps maintain continuity, responsiveness, and alignment with global stakeholders.

  

1 **How you will contribute?**  

The Global Mobility Manager – Asia\-Pacific region will be responsible for managing and supporting international mobility and immigration processes for employees relocating to and working in Australia.


The successful candidate will ensure full compliance with Australian immigration regulations while delivering efficient, practical mobility solutions that enable business operations and workforce planning.

**Job Description**

  

Job Description


We are seeking a Senior Technical Recruiter with strong semiconductor industry expertise, particularly within Integrated Device Manufacturer (IDM) environments. The role leads the full end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle while ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring managers, supported by high standards of data accuracy and process excellence. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical recruiter with deep experience managing complex semiconductor requisitions and operating effectively in a fast\-paced, global environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**End\-to\-End Technical Recruitment:**

* Lead the full recruitment cycle from requisition intake to offer acceptance.
* Develop tailored sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-fill semiconductor roles across design, manufacturing, test, packaging, and operations.

**Sourcing \& Screening:**

* Leverage multiple sourcing channels, semiconductor talent communities, niche platforms, referrals, and proactive market mapping.
* Build longlists and shortlists of qualified semiconductor professionals by applying role\-specific technical filters across semiconductor HW \& SW R\&D IC design, fabrication, equipment engineering, process engineering, test development, and related fields.

**Candidate \& Stakeholder Management:**

* Provide high\-quality CV presentations and candidate summaries to hiring managers.
* Advise hiring teams on market conditions, candidate availability, competitive intelligence, and recruitment timelines.
* Ensure consistent communication and outstanding experiences for candidates throughout the process.

**Operation \& System Excellence:**

* Manage all recruitment status updates in ATS, ensuring transparency and accuracy.
* Partner closely with cross\-functional teams including HRBPs, HR Operations, and Business Leaders for compliance and smooth Process flows.

**Industry Expertise:**

* Demonstrate strong familiarity with semiconductor roles across the IDM value chain, including:
* R\&D, SoC Architect, Performance Modelling, Chip Lead, RTL Design, Design Verification, Physical Design, STA, DFT, Validation,
* Process integration, yield engineering
* Manufacturing, Packaging, Testing
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of global semiconductor talent markets, competitive landscapes, and emerging skill trends.

description:
**Company Description**  

Oetiker provides customers with the peace of mind that their mission\-critical components are reliably connected. We are a global leader in high\-end connecting solutions for the vehicle industry and for high\-value applications in industrial segments. Our expertise in high\-quality clamps, rings, straps and quick\-connectors ranges from powertrain and drivetrain applications to medical applications. We offer engineering, prototyping and testing support to quickly create comprehensive solutions for overcoming clamping and connecting challenges. With 1800\+ employees in more than 30 countries and over 75 years of experience, we are the trusted, global, long\-term partner for the world’s leading OEMs.

 **Job Description** **Talent Acquisition Specialist Oetiker Group**


As a Talent Acquisition Specialist at Oetiker Group, you will be instrumental in enhancing our global recruitment strategies, optimizing technological tools, and advancing our vacancy reporting and talent acquisition processes. This role demands a proactive approach to managing global recruitment requirements, with a particular focus on acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for challenging and unique roles. You will play a crucial part in transitioning our practices from regional to global standards, ensuring consistency and excellence across all talent acquisition standards and practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Global Recruitment Strategy Alignment:** Collaborate with local HR teams to adapt and implement global recruitment strategies that meet regional needs. Ensure alignment of local practices with global objectives and best practices.
* **Sourcing and Talent Pool Development:** Advise on advanced sourcing techniques and tools. Assist local HR teams in developing and maintaining talent pools for hard\-to\-fill or high\-priority roles, leveraging both global and regional networks.
* **Technology Integration and Optimization:** Support the effective use of global Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment technologies. Help with system configurations, report generation, and troubleshooting to optimize technology use.
* **Training and Best Practices:** Conduct training sessions on global recruitment best practices, interviewing techniques, and candidate engagement strategies. Share insights on effective recruitment tools and platforms.
* **Process Standardization:** Assist in standardizing recruitment processes to ensure consistent candidate experience and reporting. Consult on the creation and implementation of global recruitment policies and procedures.
* **Data Analysis and Reporting:** Support local HR teams in analyzing recruitment metrics and vacancy reports. Offer insights to improve local recruitment strategies and performance.
* **Candidate Experience Enhancement:** Collaborate on strategies to improve the candidate experience. Share effective communication, feedback, and engagement techniques.
* **Recruitment Challenges and Solutions:** Serve as a consultant for complex recruitment challenges, including niche and high\-volume roles. Provide solutions based on global experience and market trends.
* **Feedback and Continuous Improvement:** Collect and analyze feedback from local HR teams to drive continuous improvement in recruitment practices and tools.

  

**Qualifications**  

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Advanced degrees or HR certifications are advantageous.
* **Experience:** 3\-5 years of experience in talent acquisition, with a proven track record in global or multi\-national environments. Demonstrated experience as a Subject Matter Expert for hard\-to\-fill or unique roles is highly desirable.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Expertise in global Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), with experience in system configuration and optimization. Proficiency in Excel and other reporting tools, with a strong understanding of global recruitment metrics and KPI reporting.
* **Project Management:** Experience in managing large\-scale projects, including system integrations, process improvements, and policy development. Ability to lead project teams and manage milestones effectively.
* **Communication and Interpersonal Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels. Strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain relationships globally.
* **Analytical and Problem\-Solving Skills:** Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop solutions to optimize recruitment processes and reporting accuracy.
* **Professionalism / Confidentiality:** High level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion, with a commitment to continuous improvement and adherence to global standards and regulations.

title: Associate Director - Talent Acquisition New
description:
### **About Zinnov**



Zinnov is a global management consulting firm that helps organizations make decisions that actually get used — and deliver results that matter. For over two decades, we’ve partnered with leading enterprises, high\-growth technology companies, and investors to answer some of the toughest questions they face:


* Where should we invest?
* How do we scale globally?
* What capabilities will win in the next decade?

Our work shapes market entry strategies, global operating models, M\&A decisions, and long\-term growth bets. We’re known for being **data\-led, execution\-focused, and outcome\-driven** — not opinion\-heavy slideware.



At Zinnov, how you work matters as much as what you deliver. We value independent thinking, crisp communication, and early ownership. With 450\+ professionals across 10 global offices, we work across industries including Digital Services, ER\&D, Enterprise Software, Semiconductors, Healthcare, BFSI, Automotive, Media \& Telecom, and Private Equity.



Zinnov isn’t for everyone. It’s for people who want steep learning curves, honest feedback, and the chance to see their work influence real business decisions — not just presentations.

**Why Globalisation Excellence**



Zinnov’s Globalisation Excellence (GE) practice helps enterprises build and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) end\-to\-end — from Design \& Discovery to Build, Scale, and Run.



In GE, you don’t work in silos. You:


* Own complex, end\-to\-end client journeys
* Work across GCC advisory, managed services, and BOT / outsourcing models
* Influence leadership decisions that shape long\-term talent and operating strategies


This is where strategy meets execution — and where talent plays a defining role.


**About the Role**



As **Associate** **Director – Talent Acquisition**, you will lead the hiring strategy and execution for a Global Capability Center (GCC) client in Hyderabad. You will own end\-to\-end recruitment across **Technology, Engineering, and Corporate/Functional roles**, partnering closely with senior stakeholders across global and regional teams.



This role is designed for a data\-driven TA leader who can scale hiring in a fast\-paced environment, build strong pipelines for niche roles, run predictable operating rhythms, and drive high\-quality outcomes through strong team leadership, stakeholder alignment, and process excellence.


**What You’ll Do**


**TA Strategy \& Workforce Planning**


* Own the end\-to\-end TA strategy across Technology, Engineering, and Functional hiring for the GCC.
* Drive workforce planning in partnership with business leaders and HRBPs — demand forecasting, prioritization, and execution plans.
* Build scalable hiring playbooks to support growth across multiple role families and seniority levels.


**Niche Hiring \& Pipeline Building**


* Build robust talent pipelines for niche and hard\-to\-hire roles through proactive sourcing beyond portals.
* Strengthen channel strategy across referrals, sourcing teams, vendors, research\-based mapping, and talent communities.
* Drive hiring outcomes across critical roles with speed, quality, and consistency.


**Stakeholder Management \& Business Partnership**


* Partner closely with senior leadership (Global / India) to understand business needs and translate them into hiring plans.
* Run structured business reviews, share market intelligence, and align on hiring trade\-offs and feasibility.
* Maintain high stakeholder confidence through clarity, cadence, and transparent progress updates.


**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**


* Lead, mentor, and scale a high\-performing TA team across recruiters, sourcers, and TA ops.
* Drive capability building on sourcing, assessment quality, role selling, tools, and candidate experience.
* Implement best practices for productivity, bandwidth allocation, and performance management.


**Process Excellence \& Candidate Experience**


* Own and optimize recruitment processes to improve turnaround time, quality of hires, and candidate experience.
* Ensure smooth coordination across sourcing, recruitment operations, onboarding, and HR teams.
* Drive offer management and conversion — engagement, negotiation, and offer\-to\-join closure discipline.


**Metrics, Reporting \& TA Dashboards**


* Build and run TA dashboards covering TAT, pipeline health, conversion ratios, offer\-to\-join, hiring forecasts, and recruiter productivity.
* Establish KPI discipline across TA teams and drive action plans based on insights.
* Present hiring trends, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership with decision\-ready narratives.


**Technology, Tools \& Continuous Improvement**


* Leverage ATS and HR tools (e.g., Greenhouse / Workday / SuccessFactors or similar) to improve hiring efficiency.
* Advocate for automation, AI tools, and process upgrades that enhance speed and quality.
* Improve data hygiene and operational rigor to ensure reliable reporting and forecasting.


**Employer Branding \& Recruitment Marketing**


* Partner with branding/communications teams to strengthen the GCC’s employer value proposition.
* Drive recruitment marketing initiatives for tech, engineering, and functional talent segments.
* Build visibility and attractiveness in talent markets through targeted campaigns and community engagement.


**What You Bring**


**Qualifications \& Experience**


* 15\+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with **5\+ years in a leadership role**.
* Strong expertise hiring across **Tech, Engineering, and Corporate/Functional** roles.
* Experience scaling hiring in a fast\-paced, stakeholder\-heavy environment (GCC / product / engineering preferred).
* Strong comfort with recruitment analytics, TA operations, and forecasting.


**Key Skills**


* TA strategy, workforce planning, and end\-to\-end hiring ownership.
* Advanced stakeholder management and executive communication.
* Strong people leadership — coaching, performance management, team scaling.
* Data\-driven execution — dashboards, funnel management, conversion optimization.
* Process rigor — structured operating rhythm, predictable delivery, high\-quality candidate experience.
* Strong sourcing and pipeline strategy for niche roles and competitive talent markets.


**What Success Looks Like**


* TA strategy translated into predictable outcomes across technology, engineering, and functional hiring.
* Healthy pipelines for niche roles, with strong funnel visibility and disciplined follow\-through.
* Improved conversion metrics — higher offer\-to\-join, faster closures, stronger candidate engagement.
* High stakeholder confidence driven by clarity, cadence, and decision\-ready reporting.
* A high\-performing TA team with strong execution standards, capability depth, and scalable operating rhythms.


**If you enjoy owning high\-scale GCC hiring end\-to\-end, influencing senior stakeholders through data and market insight, and building a high\-performing TA engine that delivers speed and quality — this role offers both impact and growth.**

**Zinnov is an equal opportunity employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

description:

As an **Analyst \- Reporting \& Analytics**, you will support the **Molex Central Finance** function. This is a **key role** responsible for supporting the implementation, stabilization, and ongoing management of the **Central Finance system at Molex** . You will play a critical role in ensuring **financial data quality, completeness, and integrity** between legacy ERP systems and Central Finance. The role requires close ownership of **financial reconciliations/tie\-outs** and error monitoring, ensuring transactional consistency between legacy systems and Central Finance, and supporting period close activities. In addition, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining **standardized financial reporting packages** for multiple stakeholder groups.

**Our Team**


You will be part of the **Global** **Central Finance** team, a group that partners closely with Finance leaders, Reporting leaders, Master data, and ERP leaders.


**What You Will Do**


* Support **Central Finance reporting and analytics activities** by working closely with the implementation partner and workstream leaders
* Perform **data tie\-outs and reconciliations** between **Central Finance, OneStream, SAP, and other source systems** to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Build working knowledge of **core financial statements** including **Trial Balance, Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and US GAAP reports** as part of training and on\-the\-job learning.
* Monitor **Application Interface Framework (AIF)** jobs to identify data load errors and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
* Execute **consolidated and unconsolidated data reconciliations** between OneStream/SAP and Central Finance.
* Escalate data issues, variances, and process gaps to workstream leaders with clear documentation and observations.
* Participate in **daily and weekly working calls**, providing status updates on assigned activities and raising risks as needed.
* Identify opportunities to **automate or streamline recurring tasks** under guidance from the team.
* Deliver assigned responsibilities in line with **defined timelines, milestones, and quality standards**.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**


* , with **2\-6 years of experience** in **Record\-to\-Report (R2R), financial reporting, planning, analysis, or consolidation**; **freshers** with a strong understanding of company financials will also be considered.
* Exposure to **financial and operational reporting**, including **GAAP reports, tax reports, costing reports, Profit \& Loss, and Balance Sheet analysis**.
* Working knowledge of **SAP General Ledger structure** and experience creating and posting **journal entries**.
* Basic understanding of **ERP backend data structures**, database files, and reporting/support tools.
* Ability to apply structured approaches to **analyze financial data and support reporting issue resolution**.
* Strong **communication and interpersonal skills**, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
* Demonstrated ability to **execute tasks independently**, while also working effectively in a team\-based environment.

**What Will Put You Ahead**


* Exposure to working with **cross\-functional stakeholders** across Finance, Operations, and Business teams.
* Understanding of **core financial concepts**, including **P\&L, costing, and statutory vs. management/consolidated reporting** **and US GAAP**

description:
**About Goldman Sachs**



At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals. For us, it’s all about bringing together people who are curious, collaborative and have the drive to make things possible for our clients and communities.


**YOUR IMPACT**



Are you a quick\-thinking self\-starter with a passion for the financial markets, have the desire to work closely with high net worth individuals and the ability to think outside the box? Our client service professionals provide proactive financial counseling, full\-service implementation, including tax preparation and investments, to address complexities of executives, entrepreneurs and high net worth individuals. We are seeking professionals with an understanding of the markets who have the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment where attention to detail, strong communication skills, and client service are essential to maintaining and enhancing our business.


**OUR IMPACT**


**Wealth Management**



Across Wealth Management, Goldman Sachs helps empower clients and customers around the world to reach their financial goals. Our advisor\-led wealth management businesses provide financial planning, investment management, banking and comprehensive advice to a wide range of clients, including ultra\-high net worth and high net worth individuals, as well as family offices, foundations and endowments, and corporations and their employees. Our consumer business provides digital solutions for customers to better spend, borrow, invest, and save. Across Wealth Management, our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading\-edge technology, data and design.


**Goldman Sachs Ayco**



Goldman Sachs Ayco (Ayco) partners with Fortune 1000 companies to design and implement tailored financial planning programs for their workforce and leveraging the 50\-year heritage of Ayco and the comprehensive resources of Goldman Sachs to meet the evolving needs of their employees. Ayco believes companies best serve their stakeholders and the greater economy when their employees financial lives are clear, understood and in their control. Ayco advisors and technical specialists help clients achieve their personal financial goals through education and guided implementation across seven key financial disciplines, including employee benefit planning.


**JOB SUMMARY AND RESPONSBILITIES**


* Serving as the primary operational driver of the Executive Wealth (EW) team by triaging incoming inquiries and tracking client priorities:
* Asist Advisor teams, who work one\-on\-one with individual and/or corporate clients providing comprehensive personal financial planning, investment planning and tax services to corporate employees, executives and other high\-net\-worth individuals
* Work closely with Wealth Advisor teams to support their AYCO clients
* Leverage your operational background and experience to contribute to a growing business
* Proactively anticipate, determine and recommend solutions to meet client needs and/or resolve issues surrounding investment related transactions
* Manage cash balances and private banking services in accounts
* Resolve time sensitive client service\-related issues, including complex situations
* Plan and manage new account onboarding process, asset transfers and other account service requests
* Managing the pipeline of new business opportunities in Salesforce
* Prepare various reports for clients in the areas of cash flow planning, income tax projections, investment allocation, investment performance, estate flowcharts, etc.
* Facilitate various aspects of client portfolio performance reporting and analysis
* Assist with tax activities, including tax return quality control, estimated payments, e\-filing
* Interface with internal groups to complete various investment and operational tasks.
* Complete positive/negative consent client emails, handle exception tracking and comments.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**


* CA fresher Jan'26 cleared
* Proficiency in Microsoft products such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality
* Enthusiastic and positive approach to problem\-solving and client service
* Proven track record with cross\-training, task\-sharing and mutually supportive teamwork
* Must be able to be innovative, pro\-actively manage time and follow through to complete tasks
* Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. **We Offer Best\-In\-Class Benefits**
Healthcare \& Medical Insurance
We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.


Holiday \& Vacation Policies
We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.


Financial Wellness \& Retirement
We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.


Health Services
We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state\-of\-the\-art on\-site health centers in certain offices.


Fitness
To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on\-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre\-approved amount).


Child Care \& Family Care
We offer on\-site child care centers that provide full\-time and emergency back\-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available.

description:
We are seeking an India\-based legally qualified professionals (Legal Executives / Corporate Consultant/ Law Graduates / Qualified Lawyers) to support our UK\-qualified solicitors in delivering high\-quality, compliant, and efficient legal services. This role will be strictly limited to unreserved legal activities. All work will be supervised by a UK\-qualified Solicitor. The legal executive must adhere to the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) regulatory boundaries and comply with strict confidentiality and data\-handling protocols.

* Role Purpose

The legal executive will provide high\-quality support to UK\-qualified solicitors. The role is focused strictly on unreserved legal activities, performed under direct supervision of UK\-qualified solicitors, in accordance with Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) rules. The legal executive will assist with document handling, client communication, drafting, research, case progression, and operational support relating to CICA matters.

***The role requires strong analytical skills, excellent written communication, high attention to detail, and a disciplined approach to confidentiality and data protection.***

* Key Responsibilities (Unreserved Activities Only)

The legal executive will perform only unreserved tasks, including but not limited to:

* Case Support and Administration
* Assist with day\-to\-day management of CICA claim files.
* Maintain case records, track deadlines, and ensure accuracy of file documentation.
* Support evidence gathering, including obtaining client information, medical records, police reports, and related documents.
* Drafting and Document Preparation
* Draft unreserved correspondence, statements, summaries, chronologies, and research memos for review by a supervising UK solicitor.
* Prepare initial drafts of CICA claim forms, schedules, and supporting submissions (subject to UK solicitor approval).
* Conduct document review and organise evidence bundles.
* Client Liaison (Within Defined Scope)
* Communicate with clients regarding factual updates and requests for information.
* Manage routine follow\-ups with clients to obtain documentation or clarify factual details.
* Ensure all client communications are properly documented and escalated to supervising solicitors where necessary.
* Legal Research and Analysis
* Perform research relating to CICA Scheme provisions, guidance materials, and procedural updates.
* Summarize key findings for supervising UK solicitors to support case strategy.
* Operational and Compliance Support
* Adhere to internal policies on confidentiality, GDPR, IT security, and secure handling of sensitive personal data.
* Maintain accurate time recording and workflow documentation as required.
* Ensure that all tasks remain strictly within the scope of unreserved legal work and escalate any borderline matters immediately.
* Prohibited (Reserved) Activities

In compliance with SRA regulatory requirements, the legal executive must not, under any circumstances:

* Provide reserved legal advice or independent legal opinions.

* Perform internal audits, supplier audits, and support external certification audits (ISO, customer\-specific, etc.).
* Ensure compliance with all relevant **ISO requirements** and customer quality specifications specific to the metal industry.
* Develop and maintain quality documentation including Quality Manuals, Procedures, Work Instructions, Control Plans, PPAP, APQP (where applicable), and Inspection \& Test Plans (ITP).
* Lead the QA team or work as a key team member in setting up and strengthening the quality department from the ground level.
* Monitor and analyze quality KPIs (rejection rate, rework, customer complaints, PPM, etc.) and drive improvements.
* Provide technical guidance on mechanical aspects of product quality, material properties, dimensional accuracy, surface finish, mechanical testing (tensile, hardness, impact, etc.), and non\-destructive testing (NDT) methods.
* Train and mentor production, engineering, and QA team members on quality standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with production, maintenance, and procurement teams to resolve quality issues and prevent recurrence.
* Lead from the front in establishing a culture of quality, discipline, and systematic functioning across the organization.

Requirements / Qualifications

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering) from a recognized university. (Master’s degree in Mechanical / Industrial Engineering or Quality Management will be an advantage)

**Experience:**

* Minimum 2\-4\+ years of relevant experience in **Quality Assurance / Quality Control** in the **Metal Industry** (Copper Plant, Foundry, Forging, Rolling Mill, Metal Fabrication, Machining, or related heavy engineering).
* Prior experience in setting up or strengthening QMS from initial stages is highly preferred.
* Hands\-on experience in leading QA functions or working as a core team member in ISO\-certified metal manufacturing organizations.

**Technical \& Functional Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of **ISO 9001:2015** (mandatory) and preferably IATF 16949, ISO 14001, or other relevant standards.
* In\-depth understanding of **Quality Management Systems (QMS)** principles, documentation, and implementation.
* Good knowledge of metal properties, manufacturing processes, mechanical testing, and inspection methodologies used in the metal industry.
* Proficiency in quality tools: FMEA, Control Plan, PPAP, APQP, MSA, SPC, 8D, Kaizen, etc.
* Experience in handling customer complaints, supplier quality development, and process audits.
* Familiarity with relevant national/international standards for metal products (IS, ASTM, EN, DIN, etc.).
* Basic knowledge of NDT techniques (UT, MPI, DPI, Radiography) and mechanical testing equipment.

**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies:**

* Proven ability to **lead from the front** and drive initiatives independently.
* Strong leadership and team\-handling skills; capable of guiding and developing a QA team.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making abilities.
* High level of ownership and commitment towards establishing systematic functioning of the organization.
* Good communication, interpersonal, and training skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* Lead Auditor / Internal Auditor certification for ISO 9001 (or IATF 16949\).
* Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to play a key role in building a strong quality culture.
* Challenging and growth\-oriented role in a dynamic metal industry setup.
* Competitive salary and benefits commensurate with experience.
